en: A black‑and‑white view through a large stone archway toward a historic European building complex. In the distance stands a church or chapel with a tall, slender spire and bulbous baroque-style roof. To its left are long steep‑roofed buildings with rows of Gothic-style windows and dormers. The foreground shows a rough stone wall and ground framed by the darker interior of the arch. At the very bottom, faint, mirrored handwriting appears on the negative.
